description: Use this when the buyer has chosen one work and wants to buy it. It answers with checkout_url, a page on Fold’s own site for that one work, where the buyer enters the delivery address, sees the total with sales tax and the terms, and pays. It charges nothing and reserves nothing: the work can still sell to someone else until the buyer presses Pay, and the link works once and lapses at expires_at. Give the link to the buyer or open it in your browser. Call check_availability first; one listing_id per call, since each work is its own purchase. If the work has sold, or another buyer is paying for it, the refusal carries out_of_stock: what the work is now, and up to three similar works on sale here to offer the buyer instead.

listing_id.description: A single listing_id from get_artwork or check_availability.
